workflow.editorial_review: recorded: 21 editorially accepted; 6 semantic holds; 1 withheld

proposals.codex_proposal: References a declared Input instead of embedding an inline literal value.
proposals.author_description: Uses the value of a declared Input.
proposals.engineering_note: The marker is an object with the required input identifier. Existence, provision, value typing and resolution are separate checks; this sentence does not promise that a supplied identifier resolves.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Uses the value of a declared Input.

proposals.codex_proposal: References a Variable by identifier instead of providing a literal; identifier resolution is checked separately from this schema.
proposals.author_description: Uses the value of a declared Variable.
proposals.engineering_note: The variable marker and identifier pattern are explicit. Identifier existence, cycles and derived types are semantic checks; the wording does not claim that string validation resolves a declaration.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Uses the value of a declared Variable.

proposals.codex_proposal: Identifier of a shared Object reused at a collection site; the schema validates its spelling, not reference resolution.
proposals.author_description: Reuses a named Object for collection.
proposals.engineering_note: This reference is a string ending in -object, not an object_ref wrapper. Object existence, capability compatibility and collection reuse behavior are checked separately.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Reuses a named Object for collection.

proposals.existing_wording: Combines Test outcomes with OVAL-aligned Boolean operators.
proposals.codex_proposal: Evaluates Test or Assessment references using the Boolean groups and conditional branches defined by the shared expression grammar.
proposals.author_description: Combines Test and Assessment outcomes using Boolean operators and conditional expressions.
proposals.engineering_note: The accepted expression grammar includes and/or/one/xor/not and if/then/else with optional else_if. Input provision has a separate guard form. Do not advertise the inactive function-call vocabulary or for_each placement, and do not infer a new multi-state truth table.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Combines Test and Assessment results using Boolean operators and conditional expressions.

proposals.existing_wording: Declared local Input provision, not truthiness or nonemptiness. Only direct evaluate if/else_if guards; absent and provided empty remain distinct.
proposals.codex_proposal: Checks provision of a declared local Input, treating an absent value differently from a provided empty value.
proposals.author_description: Checks whether a declared Input was supplied, even if its value is empty.
proposals.engineering_note: The native description distinguishes provision from truthiness/nonemptiness. The check belongs only in direct if/else_if guards; it is not a standalone evaluate expression or a guarantee that the supplied value is valid.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Checks whether a declared Input was supplied, even if its value is empty.

proposals.existing_wording: Expression that supplies this Variable’s values.
proposals.codex_proposal: Supplies the expression used to obtain the declared Variable values.
proposals.author_description: Defines how this Variable's values are obtained.
proposals.engineering_note: The declaration selects a retained expression form. Constant declarations are restricted to literal expressions; local expressions have separate type/status obligations. No broader inactive function library is implied.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Defines how this Variable's values are obtained.

proposals.codex_proposal: One field condition either compares observed values or asserts confirmed absence; local cardinality overrides must supply the complete pair required by the shared grammar.
proposals.author_description: Compares a collected field's values or checks for confirmed absence.
proposals.engineering_note: Confirmed absence is comparator-free values_found: none; it forbids comparison properties. Keep complete local cardinality overrides in subordinate help, and do not equate collection errors/not_collected with confirmed absence.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Compares a collected field or checks whether it is absent.

proposals.existing_wording: One complete Test requirement: item_requirement gives explicit existence and satisfaction counts; conditions follow as fields/and/or/one/xor. Field cardinality must be explicit.
proposals.codex_proposal: Comparison requirement with independent Item counts, a complete shared field-count policy and one field condition or Boolean condition group.
proposals.author_description: Defines the Item counts and field conditions for a comparison Test.
proposals.engineering_note: Item-presence-only requirements use a separate definition. The comparison form has independent Item policy, a complete shared field policy and a selected field/group condition; conditional occurrences remain in constraint help, not this sentence.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Defines the Item counts and field conditions for a comparison Test.

proposals.existing_wording: Explicit Item existence and satisfaction quantifiers; the two decisions remain independent.
proposals.codex_proposal: Sets the independent existence and satisfaction quantifiers for selected Items.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many Items must be found and how many must satisfy the comparison.
proposals.engineering_note: items_found and items_satisfying are distinct required members in this comparison context. These are quantifier choices, not numeric literals or a count of serialized evidence rows.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many Items must be found and how many must satisfy the comparison.

proposals.existing_wording: Selected-Item existence requirement (OVAL Test check_existence). Both source all_exist and at_least_one_exists map to one_or_more; preserve their distinct source spellings only in provenance.
proposals.codex_proposal: Selected-Item existence requirement. Editors may suggest `one_or_more` for new authoring and must serialize an explicit value.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many selected Items must exist.
proposals.engineering_note: The accepted quantifier vocabulary is distinct from field-value requirements. Do not copy historical existence spellings into author help, infer runtime defaults, or substitute retained evidence-list length for selected population.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many selected Items must exist.

proposals.existing_wording: How many collected Items must satisfy the complete condition (OVAL Test check). Never conflated with items_found.
proposals.codex_proposal: How many collected Items must satisfy the complete condition. Editors may suggest `every` for new authoring and must serialize an explicit value.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many selected Items must satisfy the comparison.
proposals.engineering_note: This quantifies Items meeting the complete condition, independently of Items found. Empty/unknown/error behavior is not redefined by the shorter description; the default annotation is an authoring concern.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many selected Items must satisfy the comparison.

proposals.existing_wording: Required shared values_found/values_matching pair for comparison Tests. The editor may offer these defaults but must serialize the complete pair. A closer complete pair overrides it; no runtime default.
proposals.codex_proposal: Provides a complete field-count policy that nested conditions can override only as a complete pair.
proposals.author_description: Sets the shared value-count requirements for fields in this comparison.
proposals.engineering_note: The values_found/values_matching pair is inherited together; a closer complete pair overrides it. Its authoring default annotation must not be presented as automatic runtime insertion.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets the shared value-count requirements for fields in this comparison.

proposals.codex_proposal: Specifies the field-value existence cardinality under the enclosing policy.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many observed values must be present for a field.
proposals.engineering_note: Read this leaf in its parent context: the shared paired requirement forbids none, even though the referenced existence-cardinality definition allows it elsewhere. Standalone confirmed absence belongs on an individual field predicate.

inherited_wording.text: State field/record existence cardinality. Preserve the OVAL entity/record all_exist distinction pending separate evidence review.

proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many values a field must have.

proposals.codex_proposal: Specifies the match cardinality for the observed values of one field.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many values must match the field's condition.
proposals.engineering_note: Value matching and value existence are independent decisions but are inherited as one policy pair. This sentence adds no rule that an unavailable value matches, fails or becomes an empty string.

inherited_wording.text: Consistent 0.4 authoring cardinality vocabulary. 'every' means all relevant results satisfy the specified comparison; source OVAL lexical values belong in provenance only.

proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many values must match the field's condition.

proposals.existing_wording: Concatenate two or more components in order. Multiple values produce the Cartesian product of component values. Components follow inherited source casting rules when a string conversion is required; incompatible values produce an error. A missing or nonexistent component yields the inherited source status; Error, Incomplete, Not Collected, and Not Applicable statuses are not silently converted to strings.
proposals.codex_proposal: Concatenate at least two ordered component expressions, taking the Cartesian product of multivalued components; native casting and unavailable-component status mappings require explicit confirmation.
proposals.author_description: Joins values from two or more components into strings, producing one result for each combination.
proposals.engineering_note: Existing native annotations state component order and Cartesian combinations. Casting, output representation and no-value/error-status mappings remain pending semantic review; examples demonstrate syntax only, not executed results.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Joins values from two or more components into strings, producing one result for each combination.

proposals.existing_wording: Capture text from each input string using the first capturing group. The source regex dialect and first-match behavior are retained; inputs with no capture group or no match produce an empty string under the inherited function contract.
proposals.codex_proposal: Extract the first capture from each input string; confirm the native regex dialect, no-match rule and status mapping before treating inherited behavior as normative.
proposals.author_description: Extracts the first capturing group's text from each input string.
proposals.engineering_note: The current native annotation specifies the first group but delegates regex dialect, no-match/no-group behavior and statuses to inherited rules. The pattern member is only a string constraint; validating it does not prove capture semantics.

checks.label: shape accepts a pattern without a capturing group

proposals.reviewed_author_description: Extracts the first capturing group's text from each input string.

proposals.existing_wording: Remove duplicate scalar values from the input. Record data is not a supported transformation operand; value ordering and status propagation remain governed by the inherited semantic contract.
proposals.codex_proposal: Remove duplicate scalar values from the input; equality, ordering and unavailable-value propagation require an explicit native contract.
proposals.author_description: Removes duplicate scalar values from a collection.
proposals.engineering_note: The native description excludes record operands, although the expression reference does not by itself close every operand type. Equality, ordering and unavailable-value propagation remain pending; no deduplication runtime is executed.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Removes duplicate scalar values from a collection.

proposals.existing_wording: Combine input values into one string using an explicit delimiter, sort mode, and order. `document` preserves input order; other modes sort before joining. Duplicates are preserved unless a separate `unique` expression removes them.
proposals.codex_proposal: Sorts or preserves input order and joins the values with the explicit delimiter.
proposals.author_description: Joins a collection's values into a string with the chosen ordering and separator.
proposals.engineering_note: delimiter, sort, order and values are explicit required inputs; duplicates are not implicitly removed. Sorting edge cases, casting and unavailable/error behavior need semantic confirmation before unqualified publication.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Joins a collection's values into a string with the chosen ordering and separator.

proposals.existing_wording: Set composition compatible with OVAL 5.12.3 set semantics. A single operand is valid for union, intersection, or difference and evaluates to that operand after its filters are applied; difference is limited to at most two operands.
proposals.codex_proposal: Composes Object collections with the chosen set operator and explicit operands.
proposals.author_description: Combines Object collections using union, intersection, or difference.
proposals.engineering_note: The native operator choices and operand shapes are explicit: one operand is permitted and difference has at most two. This sentence does not establish new Item identity, duplicate, filter-error or ordering rules.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Combines Object collections using union, intersection, or difference.

proposals.existing_wording: One field-key predicate with an explicit include/exclude Set filter action.
proposals.codex_proposal: Applies a field predicate with an explicit include or exclude action to collected Items.
proposals.author_description: Includes or excludes collected Items that match a field condition.
proposals.engineering_note: This is a collection-stage include/exclude action, not the compliance decision itself. The exclude choice is an editor authoring suggestion, not a runtime default; unknown/error predicate outcomes are not newly defined here.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Includes or excludes collected Items that match a field condition.

proposals.codex_proposal: Payload whose representation is constrained for records; this generic schema does not fully constrain non-record datatype/value consistency.
proposals.author_description: The value represented using its declared datatype.
proposals.engineering_note: This describes intended representation, not a validation guarantee: generic 0.4 does not fully enforce non-record tag/payload consistency. Status/redaction can prohibit the payload, and record rules can require it; the intent/enforcement distinction needs semantic review.

checks.label: generic tag/payload consistency is not fully constrained

proposals.reviewed_author_description: The value represented using its declared datatype.

proposals.codex_proposal: Choose one of `exists`, `does_not_exist`, `error`, `not_collected`.
proposals.author_description: Distinguishes an existing value from absence, an error, or a value that was not collected.
proposals.engineering_note: The four labels are exists, does_not_exist, error and not_collected. These are value statuses, not Boolean comparison results; propagation into Test outcomes remains a separate contract.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Distinguishes an existing value from absence, an error, or a value that was not collected.

proposals.existing_wording: Reusable runtime Item shape. Missing Items are absent from the collection, not represented as synthetic does_not_exist Items. Collection-level absence and field-level statuses remain separate.
proposals.codex_proposal: Records the fields and provenance of one entity acquired by a collector.
proposals.author_description: Records one collected entity, its fields, and supporting provenance.
proposals.engineering_note: The record requires id, capability, status, fields and provenance. Missing Items are omitted rather than emitted as synthetic does_not_exist Items; open provenance shape does not guarantee complete evidence.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Records one collected entity, its fields, and supporting provenance.

proposals.existing_wording: Runtime result of evaluating an authored Object and producing Items. Collection status is intentionally not Boolean.
proposals.codex_proposal: Records an Object collection outcome and the identities of retained or referenced Items.
proposals.author_description: Records an Object's collection outcome and supporting Item references.
proposals.engineering_note: Collection status is not Boolean. item_refs can represent retained/materially referenced evidence rather than every collected Item; logical/population completeness and error reporting remain separate fields.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Records an Object's collection outcome and supporting Item references.

proposals.existing_wording: Pre-alpha 0.4 Assessment single authoring grammar. Source conversion must emit this native grammar.
proposals.codex_proposal: Defines the metadata and mode-specific content of a manual or automated Assessment.
proposals.author_description: Defines an Assessment's metadata and its manual procedure or automated checks.
proposals.engineering_note: The mode branches distinguish a manual procedure from automated tests/evaluate and require different fields. This sentence introduces no new execution mode, branch syntax or default policy.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Defines an Assessment's metadata and its manual procedure or automated checks.

proposals.codex_proposal: When this object is present, `benchmark` must be supplied. Its semantic purpose requires owner review.
proposals.author_description: Organizes Rules, Groups, Profiles, and shared policy settings.
proposals.engineering_note: These named sections are required, but their internal policy objects are partly opaque. Confirm the organizing relationship before installing this sentence as normative; it does not define profile inheritance, selection precedence or scoring behavior. Only section-shape witnesses are supplied, not a complete Benchmark example.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Organizes Rules, Groups, Profiles, and shared policy settings.

proposals.existing_wording: External organization-supplied policy data for Parameters intentionally left unresolved by a Benchmark publisher.
proposals.codex_proposal: Supplies organization-defined policy values for Parameters intentionally delegated by a Benchmark publisher.
proposals.author_description: Supplies organizational values for Parameters delegated by a Benchmark publisher.
proposals.engineering_note: The existing root description limits this data to Parameters intentionally left unresolved by the publisher. Benchmark constraints remain authoritative; this wording does not permit overriding publisher-defined values or claim that this generic value map enforces all types/cardinalities.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Supplies organizational values for Parameters delegated by a Benchmark publisher.

proposals.existing_wording: Native 0.4 collection-expansion foreach binding. The source is one named shared/referenceable Object. Chaining is permitted: a source Object may itself use for_each, creating correlated lexical lineage. Independent multi-source Cartesian expansion is not implicit.
proposals.codex_proposal: Shared Item-lineage binding with explicit item and in properties; an authored placement is not reachable from the frozen Assessment schema.
proposals.engineering_note: No author-facing description is approved or offered. Neither foreach helper is reachable from accepted Assessment authoring; resolve placement/activation with Jack before advertising support or providing an authored for_each example.
